description: Inputs that the v2 model refuses, with the exact message. Times are epoch microseconds; series is the key of the metric x without tags. call encodeDeltas takes timestampsUs; decodeDeltas takes tStartUs, count and deltasHex; regular takes tStartUs, intervalUs, values and optional tEndUs and qualityHex; irregular takes timestampsUs, values and optional tEndUs. Run by python-package (tests/test_model_v2.py) and opentsx-model (ModelRefusalVectorsTest).

cases.name: encode: equal timestamps
cases.error: timestamps: timestamp 1 is not after timestamp 0; expected strictly increasing timestamps

cases.name: encode: falling timestamps
cases.error: timestamps: timestamp 2 is not after timestamp 1; expected strictly increasing timestamps

cases.name: decode: input ends before the second varint
cases.error: timeDeltas: input ends inside a varint; expected complete varints

cases.name: decode: input ends inside a varint
cases.error: timeDeltas: input ends inside a varint; expected complete varints

cases.name: decode: one byte too many
cases.error: timeDeltas: 1 trailing bytes; expected exactly 1 varints for 2 timestamps

cases.name: decode: varint of 11 bytes
cases.error: timeDeltas: varint longer than 10 bytes; expected at most 10 bytes per varint

cases.name: decode: tenth byte above 64 bits
cases.error: timeDeltas: varint exceeds 64 bits; expected at most 64 bits per varint

cases.name: regular: interval 0
cases.error: intervalMicros: "0" is not allowed; expected a positive number of microseconds

cases.name: regular: negative interval
cases.error: intervalMicros: "-1000000" is not allowed; expected a positive number of microseconds

cases.name: regular: tEnd cuts off the last value
cases.error: tEnd: "20" is not after the last timestamp 20; expected a time after the last timestamp

cases.name: regular: empty with tEnd at tStart
cases.error: tEnd: "1000000" is not after tStart 1000000; expected a time after tStart

cases.name: regular: two quality bytes for one value
cases.error: quality: length 2 differs from the count 1; expected one byte per value

cases.name: irregular: more timestamps than values
cases.error: timestamps: length 2 differs from the length 1 of values; expected one timestamp per value

cases.name: irregular: no value
cases.error: values: empty; expected at least one value

cases.name: irregular: tEnd at the last timestamp
cases.error: tEnd: "5" is not after the last timestamp 5; expected a time after the last timestamp

cases.name: irregular: equal timestamps
cases.error: timestamps: timestamp 1 is not after timestamp 0; expected strictly increasing timestamps

cases.name: irregular: equal timestamps and tEnd at the last one
cases.error: timestamps: timestamp 1 is not after timestamp 0; expected strictly increasing timestamps
